title: Expose desktop project operations
responsibility: Connect desktop project, planning, evidence and agent operations to the selected project session.

inputs.name: desktopBridge.context
inputs.description: Selected project session, provider discovery, task/image run service, folder chooser and optional session-liveness check.

inputs.name: prepareFeaturePlan.input
inputs.description: Exact project and source commit, original user request, shared feature goal/TLDR, module changes with wanted contracts, dependency-ordered task definitions, and one committed current or wanted image reference plus optional edit region for each affected page.

outputs.name: desktopBridge
outputs.description: Selected-project desktop operations with repository-serialized planning writes.

outputs.name: projectWork
outputs.description: Reads one exact selected-project committed task-queue snapshot and rechecks project identity and session liveness.

outputs.name: prepareFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Generates three distinct GPT Image choices per affected page from the exact current/wanted reference, passes the original request and requested region, verifies and commits artifacts, wanted contracts and dependency-ordered tasks as an unapproved plan; never dispatches.

outputs.name: selectFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Serializes selection for the current writable source and exact latest plan digest; creates a new unapproved digest.

outputs.name: approveFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Readiness-checks explicit approval of the visible digest, submits only its task records, then runs their dependency-aware workers within trusted memory limits and returns actual results.

errors.name: foreign or stale project/plan
errors.description: Rejects before writing or dispatch when project, source revision, digest, reference, page coverage or approval is stale or foreign.

errors.name: preparation failure
errors.description: Missing/unsafe reference, incomplete design coverage, generator, artifact or metadata failure rejects without a partial committed plan or worker dispatch.

errors.name: dispatch failure
errors.description: Queue/readiness failures reject; worker outcomes are returned as actual results and are not represented as completed when they failed.
